card.text: Ultracool red dwarf in Aquarius with seven Earth-sized planets.

introduction.text: TRAPPIST-1 is a star the size of Jupiter, 12.5 parsecs away. Seven transiting planets orbit it, all of them closer than Mercury is to the Sun.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: Gaia's spectrum of the star as a uniform disc. Too faint in blue to measure there; no surface picture exists.
